SourceDocument.Description:
Waters each part of the yard only when it needs water.
Choose what grows in each area, how it is watered, and any times when watering must be paused. Smart Sprinkler uses recent rain, current weather, and the forecast to choose a safe watering time and amount. It also counts manual watering, keeps working during short internet outages, and reminds you to prepare the system for freezing weather.

List.Description:
Waters each lawn, garden, or planted area according to its plants, watering method, recent rain, forecast weather, and user-selected adjustments. The user chooses the weather source, where area controls and reports will be available, reminder recipients, and each area's valve, plant type, and watering method. The user can manually change each area's watering percentage and no-watering periods at any time, or winterize and reactivate the whole system. The sprinkler automatically schedules and operates each valve around rain, forecast precipitation, wind, freezing temperatures, plant needs, and no-watering periods, and uses saved estimates during short weather outages. The sprinkler shows each area's current status, water estimate, valve state, and upcoming watering plan. The sprinkler provides water-balance, daily water-use, and recorded-and-forecast weather graphs, and sends selected people reminders before freezing weather.
Change log: updated protocol variants.
Choose the local weather service used for rain, temperature, wind, and forecasts. Smart Sprinkler can use saved estimates during short outages.
